question: What is the name of India’s first maritime-sector NBFC?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Sagarmala Finance Corporation Limited (SMFCL)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister Sonowal inaugurates India’s 1st maritime sector NBFC, Sagarmala Finance Corporation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India’s first maritime NBFC**, the **Sagarmala Finance Corporation Limited (SMFCL)**, was **inaugurated**.

 
 
• 
 
SMFCL will provide **sector-specific financial solutions** for:

 
 
• 
 
**Ports**

 
 
• 
 
**MSMEs**

 
 
• 
 
**Startups**

 
 
• 
 
**Maritime institutions**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Launch of **SAGAR SETU** platform to boost:

 
 
• 
 
**Operational efficiency**

 
 
• 
 
**Ease of doing business**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
A **standardised Scale of Rates (SoR)** template was released to ensure **uniform port tariffs** across **Major Port Authorities**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Gateway to Green** report was unveiled to promote:

 
 
• 
 
Transition of ports to **green hydrogen hubs**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
The Ministry signed an **MoU with CDAC** to set up a **Digital Centre of Excellence**, supporting **digital transformation** in the maritime sector.
